limitations: PASS counts are exact anchored lines in copied C++ reports; wrapper PASS console lines and Python helper output are excluded.
Repeated executions across missions, modes and resolutions are counted separately; they are not unique test definitions.
Staged image artifacts and paired rendered-contribution checks are separate metrics and are not added to C++ assertions.
Pixel contribution is not semantic segmentation, natural hand anatomy validation, FPS measurement or human testing.
No network-disconnected run, participant playtest or performance result is inferred from this queue.
Legacy suites without per-suite hashes use the final queue hash plus independently verified current package hash; timestamps and copied reports were checked.
